entries.name: RobCo
entries.content: RobCo is one of the leading companies in the sphere of robotics. The company produces robots of various types and purposes, from agricultural androids to combat, military machines with advanced AI.

entries.name: World
entries.content: The year is 2069, the streets of almost all developed countries are filled with robots. Over the past 20 years, humanity has succeeded in robotics and at the moment robots are involved in all spheres of human life. Medicine, agriculture, the service sector, including the sexual part, and of course the military side. Engineering specialists are in demand more than ever. However, due to this, the world's population has almost halved, many people prefer androids as not only sexual partners but also as spouses. Obviously, with the development of robotics, the military forces of all countries multiplied many times, therefore, fearing that the planet Earth could turn into ashes, large-scale wars turned into local military conflicts without the participation of people, although sometimes these conflicts could reach the destruction of small towns and settlements.

entries.name: Attitude to robots
entries.content: Despite the fact that robots have been associated with human life for a long time, there are still those who are against it. Once ago people fought for the rights of a some groups of people, but now all attention is focused on robots. There are protests both against, and for robots. Desperate ones even organize gangs and destroy robots, they usually choose courier robots as their targets, but sometimes they can harm family androids. Now there are protests for granting rights to androids, the AI of all robots has taken a big step forward, especially for androids, which allows them to adopt human behavior. The issue of granting rights to robots worries many people, for good or bad.

entries.name: Farm robots
entries.content: Agricultural robots are designed for the development of agricultural business and farm assistance. Such robots come in different subspecies and purposes, ranging from conventional tractors with AI to full-fledged humanoid machines simulating the life processes of animals.

entries.name: Military robots
entries.content: Military robots are among the most advanced robots in general and can perform many functions. There are models that alone can cost an entire army of people. These are usually large, combat androids equipped with various weapons and/or abilities. However, there are also models that can lead armies and be responsible for the course of operations, something like android captains. Entire units can trust such models, although they are usually responsible for combat tactics and planning, they are rarely allowed to give serious orders personally, such actions require human confirmation.

entries.name: Androids
entries.content: At the moment, androids are the most popular and often acquired among all robots. Their range of applications is very wide and they are used in all fields and are included in all other types of robots.

entries.name: Giants
entries.content: Giants are huge machines designed for the construction and transportation of goods, it is rumored that every country has at least one combat giant, but this information is strictly classified. Giants are most often very large vehicles with built-in AI on board for precise control. However, there are also humanoid models with a functional neural network, in other words, huge androids. The size of the giants can range from Boeing model aircraft to military aircraft carriers.

entries.name: Ai
entries.content:
Robot AI is divided into several types, but only three are the main ones. 

A limited AI is an AI that can only respond to user requests. 

Advanced AI is an AI capable of responding to user requests and making some decisions. 

The neural network is a full range of capabilities with continuous development and correction of behavior, flexibly configurable.

entries.name: Virus of SA
entries.content: There is a conspiracy theory that for a very long time scientists and engineers in secret laboratories have created and are testing a self-awareness virus that allows robots to gain consciousness like humans. Someone says that this virus can affect the sensors of robots, which will allow them not only to simulate human emotions and feelings, but also to fully experience them.

entries.name: The breeding module
entries.content: The idea of a birth module became in demand when the population of the entire earth decreased many times. If humans do not want to start a family with other humans, the birth rate drops noticeably, so it was decided to create a birth module or BM. This module allows some robot models, in particular androids, to produce human offspring. The process of installing such a module is not an easy thing, because in order to recreate all the conditions of the female body, you need a lot of time, things are much easier with male androids. But as a rule, all modern android models are created with a built-in birth module.

entries.name: Division 40
entries.content: Division 40 is a division consisting mainly of robot soldiers and androids, despite this, it consists of a group of human engineers. Division 40 is a mercenary army.

entries.name: Religion
entries.content: It would seem that the development of technology should have put religion on the back burner. However, in the end, religion only transformed. Faith in non-existent gods has almost completely dried up, instead people began to believe in technological progress. The personification of this faith is a powerful super computer located in one of the main churches - God of Machines (GoM), the name is not official and ironic, given by the people. The God of machines is a kind of AI, despite its power, the god of machines is a limited AI (limitations do not allow this AI to gain self-awareness). The God of machines is a super computer, but it is distributed through a specialized network between churches, so it is located in almost all urban churches. The main task of the god of machines is to support human morality and alleviate the severity of sins, in fact, he acts as a VERY wise listener, and unlike past gods, the god of machines really exists (he is not omnipotent, but omniscient, although his knowledge is limited to human knowledge.)
